what: The original branch through the runner's pause at the process slot (bit-for-bit expected).
outcome: the runner paused at the process slot on the first radiative step and Python answered the frame; the resume then failed on every rank with ValueError: tuple.index(x): x not in tuple, and the stage was tainted
diagnosis: ImageSegmentRunner.resume numbered the paused name with RunnerSpec.kernel_id, which indexed the manifest's kernels only; the process slot is numbered after them (id 3) and was not in that tuple.  run_original had been given the right numbering, resume had not.  Not a fault of the image or the pause: the frame was decoded and answered; the failure is in the Python runner's bookkeeping.
disposition: kernel_id now indexes the pauses (kernels, then the process slot); a fake-image test drives start, frame, original and resume through id 3; both gates resubmitted as p23-rad-original2 and p23-rad-pymlp-live2.
bfb_record_note: the job's comparison (.bfb.json) and health (.health.json) files of the failed run are kept with this record
